uniteDbPokemon.notes: Unite-DB public pokemon.json. v3 enumerates skills, boosted basic attacks, nested upgrade choices, Plus/enhanced effects, Unite Moves, and Unite Buffs.

sourceList.originalDescription: Whenever the user deals damage with a Basic Attack, Boosted Attack, Wing Attack, or Sky Attack, the target is left with a burn and a burn counter that caps at 5 stacks. The burn and burn counter lasts 4s and deals damage every 0.5s. If Incinerate or Heat Wave are used, the burn is cleansed and the burn counter is consumed, increasing the damage of those moves by 10% per burn counter stack.

Moltres strikes opponents with their beak. Becomes a boosted attack every fourth attack, swiping with their flaming wing. Once a boosted attack hits a target, the user gains one free move use for 3s. After this move is used or the duration expires, Moltres gains 600 unite energy. This unite energy can be boosted by Energy Amp and other similar effects.
No English description available in Unite-DB JSON.
The user dashes in the designated direction, dealing damage along the path.
The user dashes in the designated direction, dealing damage along the path. Each hit increases the user's Def and SpDef by 8% for 4s, stacking up to 5 times.
Grants a shield on a successful hit for 3s.
The user hurls a fiery orb in the designated direction, dealing damage to all opponents hit.
The user exhales hot breath in the designated direction, dealing damage and granting health regeneration. This health regeneration lasts 2s and ticks every 0.5s. 4% of Max HP
Lowers the cooldown of this move by 1s for each Pokémon from the opposing team hit.

The user becomes Unstoppable and soars upwards before unleashing a blazing orb towards the designated area, dealing damage, applying 5 ticks of burn damage instantly, and 5 stacks of burn counter to all enemies hit. For 20s afterwards, a modest area around the opposing team's goal zones are revealed. Moltres cannot gain unite energy from KO'ing wild Pokémon or scoring.
Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield Buff duration: 6
